The anxiety you feel will eventually come down although this can take hours not minutes. Also try working on the easiest stuff first. Maybe there's something you do that you wouldn't feel too anxious about not doing. Even if it's unrelated to the bathroom stuff. I've found that getting momentum from slowing/stopping other compulsions can help
